description: Defines the MFAudioEncoder class for encoding PCM audio into AAC using Windows Media Foundation. Includes class declaration, private members, state management, and method signatures related to audio encoding, processing, and error handling.

classes.name: MFAudioEncoder
classes.description: Encodes PCM audio samples into AAC format asynchronously using Windows Media Foundation. Manages encoder states, input/output queues, and COM interactions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with options, output callback, and completion callback.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Enqueues audio data for encoding, with capture time and completion callback.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Processes all queued data and finalizes encoding, invoking callback upon completion.
